tagline: Open-licence data feeds, refreshed every 12 hours
website_summary: DataForge IT sells cleaned, ready-to-use datasets built only from openly licensed public sources, refreshed every 12 hours, plus custom data feed and IT services.
quick_prompts: How do I receive my data?
Can you build a custom data feed?

faq.question: What datasets are available in your catalog?
faq.answer:
Our catalogue only includes datasets built from sources whose licences allow commercial reuse:
• **openFDA** (public domain): drug recalls, food recalls, medical device classifications and the drug NDC directory.
• **arXiv** paper metadata (CC0): recent AI research papers.
• **Wikimedia pageviews** (CC0): Wikipedia attention trends.
• **World universities** and **Open Brewery DB** directories (MIT licence).
Each card in the **Data Catalog** shows its source and licence, and has a free 50-row sample CSV.

faq.question: How often is data refreshed?
faq.answer: Datasets are refreshed on a 12-hour schedule (**06:00 and 18:00 Sydney time**). Each dataset card shows exactly when it was last updated.

faq.question: How do I receive my data after paying?
faq.answer: After your payment is confirmed, we run a fresh extract, review it for accuracy and privacy, and then email it to your PayPal email address as soon as possible. Nothing is sent until it has been checked.

faq.question: How does pricing and the new member discount work?
faq.answer: Every dataset shows a monthly subscription price and a one-off price on its card. Monthly plans get a **10% new member discount**, already shown on each card and applied at checkout. A monthly plan covers one month of 12-hourly updates with no automatic renewal. Prices are in USD.

faq.question: Can you build a custom data feed?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the **Request Custom Data Feed** form on this page to describe the data you need. We only work with sources that allow the data to be used and shared, and we'll reply by email.

faq.question: What is your refund policy?
faq.answer: If a one-off dataset is faulty or not delivered, we refund the purchase. If a subscription delivery fails because of an error on our side, we refund that month. This is in addition to your rights under the Australian Consumer Law. See our **Refund Policy** page for details.

faq.question: How do I contact you?
faq.answer: Use the contact form on this page and we'll reply by email as soon as possible.
